summary.headline: Rules of Astrological Fulfillment
summary.text: Astrological rules for whether hoped-for matters are fulfilled or overturned according to benefics, malefics, planetary terms, signs, stations, eclipses, and angular positions. It explains the timing, agents, causes, and manner of a matter’s turning, invoking Saturn, Jupiter, Mercury, Mars, Venus, the Sun, and Moon.
